description: Source code for SensorPoseProvider implementation, managing sensor event queues, sensor enabling/disabling, and event processing for head tracking in Android.

classes.name: EventQueueGuard
classes.description: RAII wrapper for SensorEventQueue to manage registration and deregistration on the looper.

classes.name: SensorEnableGuard
classes.description: RAII wrapper to enable a sensor on creation and disable it on destruction.

classes.name: SensorPoseProviderImpl
classes.description: Implementation of SensorPoseProvider that manages sensor event handling, threading, and listener notification.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a SensorPoseProvider instance.

methods.name: startSensor
methods.description: Enables a sensor with specified sampling period.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the provider's state.

methods.name: threadFunc
methods.description: Main loop running on the worker thread, handling looper events and sensor events.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming sensor events and notifies the listener.

methods.name: getSensorFormat
methods.description: Determines the data format of a sensor based on its type.

methods.name: getSensorByHandle
methods.description: Retrieves sensor information by handle, searching static and dynamic sensor lists.

methods.name: updateEventTimestamp
methods.description: Updates timestamp and period statistics for sensor events.

methods.name: parseEvent
methods.description: Parses raw sensor event data into pose and twist information based on format.
